summary: Iteration 2 testing covers new notification + Web Push + reminder loop features. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass against the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering (a) task_assigned regression on POST /api/tasks, (b) task_updated on admin PATCH for price/due_time/due_at/due_day_of_week, (c) reassignment notifies new (task_assigned) + old (task_updated 'moved off your list'), (d) worker status-only PATCH does NOT spawn task_updated, (e) /api/goals admin-assign creates goal owned by worker + goal_assigned notif (🎯 prefix), (f) /api/goals as worker for another user returns 403, (g) /api/goals admin with no assignee defaults to self, (h) /api/push/public-key returns key+available, (i) POST /api/push/subscribe upserts (verified single DB doc), (j) POST /api/push/unsubscribe marks is_active=false, (k) reminder_loop fires task_due_soon within 75s when due_time is ~15min ahead AND dedup holds across next tick (verified last_reminder_date persists today's ISO). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): /admin shows potential-weekly-total ($837.50) and potential-monthly-total ($3350.00); /admin/goals exposes assign-goal-btn and a complete dialog with all expected testids (assign-worker, assign-title, assign-target, assign-period, assign-allocation, assign-deadline, assign-link, confirm-assign), submitting valid values produced the 'Goal assigned 🎯' toast; /worker/profile shows push-toggle with label 'Enable push notifications'; NotificationBell opens its panel for the new worker (empty state). PushPrompt banner did NOT surface in headless Chromium — expected because isPushSupported() requires Notification+PushManager+serviceWorker in window, which headless Chromium does not fully expose; per task note we did not block on this.
action_items: (Optional) Consider falling back to a 'Notifications unsupported in this browser' static hint in PushPrompt when isPushSupported() returns false, so manual QA in headless/older browsers still sees the section.
(Optional) Add the missing aria-describedby to the AdminGoals Assign dialog (Radix a11y warning still present in console).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reminder_loop: uses now_utc() consistently and races safely via filtered update_one ($ne today_iso) + post-check fresh.last_reminder_date — correct dedup.
server.py PATCH /api/tasks resets last_reminder_date to None on any schedule change or reassignment, so updated deadlines re-fire — correct behavior.
server.py: web push send_web_push() wraps webpush call in try/except and tags 404/410 endpoints inactive — good resilience.
server.py POST /api/goals uses query params (Body removed in favor of Query) — works but is unusual; future maintenance should consider JSON body. Tests adapted via requests params=.

Frontend PushPrompt: hides itself when isPushSupported() is false. In headless Chromium without Notification API, the banner is invisible. Acceptable for now but consider a graceful 'unsupported' info card so workers on unsupported browsers still see notification controls.
All Mongo queries use {_id:0} projections — no ObjectId leakage observed.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all testid-driven flows pass; PushPrompt banner not asserted in headless — expected per task instructions)

test_credentials: Admin admin@clockwork.com / admin123 (verified). UI test worker created at runtime: uipush_<ts>@clockwork.com / worker123 (UI Push Worker). Backend test workers (notif_w1_*, notif_w2_*) auto-cleaned via DELETE /api/workers/{id} fixture.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests: 2 transient workers + several TEST_-prefixed tasks + 3 TEST_-prefixed goals (cleanup deletes workers which cascades). UI test: 1 transient worker + 1 UI_Test_Goal_<ts>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://labor-admin-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (REQUIRED — test file does not hardcode). Reminder test takes ~75-140s due to scheduler tick (60s) + dedup verification (65s). pymongo direct DB access is used only to reset last_reminder_date and verify push_subscriptions upsert/is_active. /api/goals accepts QUERY params (not JSON body); use requests params= when calling it. PushPrompt banner only renders when window.PushManager + Notification API + serviceWorker are all present — headless Chromium typically lacks one, so it stays hidden (not a bug).
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no blocking issues found. New notification, push subscription, and reminder loop features all behave per spec.
